component.name: Polifonia
component.summary: Multi-Speaker and Multi-Monitor Audio Unison Engine for Linux

description.p: Polifonia is an advanced, PipeWire-native multi-speaker audio compositing and acoustic DSP management system for Linux desktops.

It enables workstations with heterogeneous multi-monitor setups (HDMI or DisplayPort integrated screen speakers, USB audio DACs, auxiliary subwoofers, and analog outputs) to aggregate disparate physical outputs into a unified, phase-aligned, frequency-filtered multichannel virtual soundstage.

ul.li: Dynamic hardware discovery for multi-monitor displays, DACs, and auxiliary speakers
Sample-accurate delay compensation for acoustic distance delta and hardware buffer alignment
Active 2.1 acoustic crossover DSP with Linkwitz-Riley filters
Horizontal mixing console UI built with modern GTK4 and Libadwaita
System tray companion indicator for quick volume control and unison toggle

description.p: Standardized project naming to Polifonia, added AppStream metadata and Flathub distribution support.
Added device bus detection, latency estimation, and custom labeling UI for audio sinks.
